Maya: Quick shoutout — @Hamid jumped onto the late demo and hot-fixed the streaming bug in prod. Also brought lattes for the night crew :coffee: :tada:
Hamid: oh wow didn’t realize the lattes made it through the door, glad it helped. team effort tho — Leo helped debug the logs with me.
Leo: yup, that log filter saved us. nice catch on the off-by-one counter. :eyes:
Sam: Huge thanks from the CS demo team — demo went smoothly after the patch. sending extra kudos to Hamid and Leo :raised_hands:
Priya: adding a virtual thank-you card: https://kudos.redwood/team/hamid-leo — drop a quick note if you were on the call :sparkles:
Maya: Also tagging @ops-bot to schedule a follow-up recap so we can add it to runbook.
ops-bot: Follow-up created: "late-demo-streaming-issue" assigned to Hamid, due in 3 days. (link: https://tracker.redwood/issue/9876)
Sam: Honestly love that someone still brings coffee at 11pm. Next time we owe you snacks. :baguette_bread:
Hamid: HA — I accept snacks as a contingency plan. thanks everyone. great collaboration.
Leo: quick note for docs team — I'll add the log-filter snippet to the troubleshooting guide:
```
# filter streaming debug
grep "kv-cache-miss" /var/log/streaming.log | tail -n 200
```
Maya: Awesome. Sending a tiny reward via People Ops for the late shift heroics. :medal:
Priya: Dropping a GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/thank-you-team-3o7qE1YN7aBOFPRw8E (heart)
Sam: +1 to everything. Appreciate the hustle and the lattes. :heartpulse:
